pillars.name: Physical Health
pillars.description: The body you live in, looked after on purpose: screenings and check-ups kept on schedule, long-term conditions managed rather than endured, medicines and results kept in order, and the small daily habits that decide how the next thirty years feel.

pillars.name: Fitness & Sport
pillars.description: Training, play and competition: building strength, endurance and skill in a sport or a gym, structuring blocks of work around events, recovering properly, and keeping the sessions honest with a log rather than a feeling.

pillars.name: Food & Nutrition
pillars.description: What gets eaten, and how it gets to the table: meal planning, shopping and batch cooking, dietary needs and goals, cooking skill as a lifelong craft, and the food rituals that hold a household together.

pillars.name: Mental & Emotional Wellbeing
pillars.description: The inner weather: managing stress and anxiety, recovering from burnout, therapy and support, rest and attention, mood and emotional skills, and the routines that keep a mind steady when life is not.

pillars.name: Relationships & Friendship
pillars.description: The people who make a life: a partner, close friends, wider circles and new connections, kept in good repair through attention, honest conversations, shared plans and the occasions worth marking.

pillars.name: Family & Parenting
pillars.description: Raising children and holding a family together: each stage from pregnancy to young adulthood, schooling and activities, family logistics and traditions, extended family, and the decisions parents make together.

pillars.name: Personal Finance
pillars.description: The day-to-day money system: income, budget, bills, debt, savings buffers, insurance, tax and big purchases, run so that nothing surprises you and every pound has a job.

pillars.name: Wealth & Investing
pillars.description: Building long-term wealth: pensions and retirement accounts, index investing, property, side income, estate planning and the slow, boring decisions that compound over decades.

pillars.name: Career Growth
pillars.description: A working life steered rather than drifted: job searches and promotions, reputation and network, pay negotiations, career changes, credentials, and the evidence that you are getting better at what you do.

pillars.name: Craft & Mastery
pillars.description: Getting genuinely good at something with your hands or your head: woodwork and making, repair, deliberate practice, apprenticeships and portfolios, and the long arc from beginner to expert.

pillars.name: Lifelong Learning
pillars.description: Learning as a habit for life: degrees and courses, self-directed study, reading with intent, memory and note-taking systems, exams and certifications, and turning curiosity into understanding.

pillars.name: Writing & Storytelling
pillars.description: Putting words to work: fiction and non-fiction, journals and essays, newsletters and blogs, screenwriting and poetry, editing and publishing, and the daily practice that gets a manuscript finished.

pillars.name: Arts & Music
pillars.description: Making and performing art: an instrument or a voice, painting and drawing, photography and film, dance and theatre, exhibitions and gigs, and the practice routines that keep a creative life alive.

pillars.name: Faith & Meaning
pillars.description: What a life is for: religious practice and community, prayer and meditation, sacred texts and study, values and philosophy, rites of passage, and the questions worth returning to every year.

pillars.name: Community & Volunteering
pillars.description: Showing up for the people around you: neighbourhood life, volunteering and mentoring, clubs and associations, mutual aid, local events and charitable giving that is planned rather than reactive.

pillars.name: Civic Life
pillars.description: Taking part in how things are run: voting and elections, local councils and consultations, campaigning and advocacy, jury service, public meetings and staying informed without drowning in news.

pillars.name: Home & Household
pillars.description: The place you live and the machinery that keeps it running: cleaning and chores, maintenance and repairs, renovations, moving house, garden, storage, utilities and the household routines everyone shares.

pillars.name: Environment & Sustainability
pillars.description: Living more lightly: home energy and carbon, waste and repair, sustainable transport and food, climate-aware money, local conservation and the household changes that actually move the numbers.

pillars.name: Travel & Adventure
pillars.description: Going places: trip planning and bookings, long journeys and short breaks, travel documents and money, expeditions and once-in-a-lifetime trips, and the memories kept afterwards.

pillars.name: Nature & Outdoors
pillars.description: Time outside, on purpose: hiking and wild camping, birding and wildlife, foraging and growing, water and mountains, outdoor skills and safety, and a seasonal rhythm that gets you out of the house.

pillars.name: Digital Life & Personal Tech
pillars.description: The devices and accounts a modern life depends on: passwords and security, backups and photos, email and files, home networks, screen time, digital legacy and the personal tech projects worth building.

pillars.name: Caregiving
pillars.description: Caring for someone who needs you: an ageing parent, a disabled child or partner, someone through serious illness, coordinating appointments and benefits, care at home or in a home, and the carer's own limits.

pillars.name: Hobbies & Play
pillars.description: Things done for the joy of them: games and puzzles, collecting, model making, gaming, crafts and pastimes, clubs and conventions, and protecting time for play in an adult schedule.

pillars.name: Pets & Animals
pillars.description: Living with animals: choosing and welcoming a pet, health and vet care, training and exercise, food and grooming, pet-sitting and travel, horses and livestock, and the end-of-life decisions.

pillars.name: Life Admin & Paperwork
pillars.description: The paperwork that runs a life: identity documents, contracts and renewals, tax returns, wills and powers of attorney, records and filing, and the annual admin sweep nobody enjoys but everyone needs.

pillars.name: Character & Personal Growth
pillars.description: Becoming the person you intend to be: habits and discipline, confidence and courage, focus and time, reflection and reviews, life vision and goals, and the honest feedback that makes growth real.

pillars.name: Ageing Well & Later Life
pillars.description: The decades after full-time work: planning and starting retirement, staying active and connected, downsizing, legacy and family history, grandparenting, and the practical decisions of later life.

pillars.name: Languages & Culture
pillars.description: Other languages and other ways of living: learning and keeping a language, heritage and roots, cultural fluency, living abroad, translation and the literature, film and food that come with it.

pillars.name: Founding & Startups
pillars.description: Starting and steering a young company: validating the idea, incorporating, finding product-market fit, the founder's operating rhythm, co-founder relationships, runway and the hard calls of the early years.

pillars.name: Strategy & Leadership
pillars.description: Setting direction and leading people toward it: strategy and planning cycles, objectives and key results, the executive team, decision-making, culture, change programmes and the board.

pillars.name: Sales & Revenue
pillars.description: Turning interest into revenue: prospecting and pipeline, discovery and demos, proposals and negotiation, forecasting, key accounts, sales process, enablement and compensation.

pillars.name: Marketing & Brand
pillars.description: Making the right people know and want what you do: positioning and brand, campaigns and content, search and paid channels, email and lifecycle, events, and measuring what actually drives demand.

pillars.name: Communications & PR
pillars.description: How an organisation is heard: press and media relations, executive voice, internal communications, crisis handling, announcements, reputation monitoring and the messaging that holds it together.

pillars.name: Product Management
pillars.description: Deciding what to build and why: discovery and research, roadmaps and prioritisation, specs and launches, pricing and packaging, product analytics, and the feedback loops that keep a product honest.

pillars.name: Software Engineering
pillars.description: Building and running software: architecture and code quality, delivery and release, testing, infrastructure and reliability, incidents, technical debt, developer experience and engineering teams.

pillars.name: Design & UX
pillars.description: Shaping how things look, feel and work: user experience and interface design, research and testing, design systems, accessibility, content design, prototyping and design operations.

pillars.name: Data & Analytics
pillars.description: Turning data into decisions: metrics and dashboards, data pipelines and warehouses, experimentation, forecasting and modelling, machine learning, data quality and governance.

pillars.name: IT & Security
pillars.description: Keeping an organisation's technology working and safe: devices and identity, access control, backups and recovery, security programmes and audits, vendors, incident response and user support.

pillars.name: Business Operations
pillars.description: Making the organisation run: processes and playbooks, tooling and systems, facilities and workplace, quality, planning cadences, cross-team coordination and continuous improvement.

pillars.name: Supply Chain & Procurement
pillars.description: Getting the right things in at the right cost: sourcing and suppliers, purchasing, inventory, logistics and fulfilment, manufacturing partners, contracts and supply risk.

pillars.name: Finance & Accounting
pillars.description: The money side of a business: bookkeeping and the monthly close, cash flow, budgeting and forecasting, billing and collections, payroll, tax, audit and financial controls.

pillars.name: People & HR
pillars.description: Hiring, developing and keeping good people: recruitment, onboarding, performance and development, pay and benefits, policies and employee relations, wellbeing, culture and offboarding.

pillars.name: Legal & Compliance
pillars.description: Staying lawful and protected: contracts and commercial terms, corporate governance, data protection, intellectual property, regulatory compliance, disputes, policies and certifications.

pillars.name: Customer Success & Support
pillars.description: Keeping customers successful and staying: onboarding and adoption, support operations, account health and renewals, help content, feedback loops, escalations and customer advocacy.

pillars.name: Partnerships & Business Development
pillars.description: Growing through others: channel and reseller programmes, integrations and alliances, co-marketing, marketplaces, affiliates, joint ventures and the partner relationships that compound.

pillars.name: Fundraising & Investor Relations
pillars.description: Raising capital and keeping investors informed: rounds from pre-seed to growth, grants and debt, the data room, cap table, investor updates, board reporting and exits.

pillars.name: Freelancing & Agency Work
pillars.description: Selling expertise by the project or the retainer: winning clients, scoping and pricing, delivery and client communication, contracts and invoicing, utilisation, and growing a practice or studio.

pillars.name: E-commerce & Retail
pillars.description: Selling physical and digital products: storefronts and marketplaces, merchandising and pricing, product launches, conversion, returns and reviews, shops and markets, and seasonal trading.

pillars.name: Education & Teaching
pillars.description: The work of educators: curriculum and lesson planning, assessment and feedback, classroom practice, pastoral care, tutoring and coaching, school leadership and the professional development of teachers.

pillars.name: Science & Research
pillars.description: Doing research for a living: research questions and literature, study design and ethics, lab and field work, data and analysis, writing and peer review, grants, collaborations and a research career.
